title: Pretrained models: what comes ready made

videos.script: Every model in this course was made the same way. A network read an enormous amount of text and learnt to guess the next word. That is what you get when you pick one: a pretrained model. {{box}} It comes with more than the network. A tokenizer, a template for conversations, a card that says what it was made for, and a licence. Through an API you see none of them. {{base}} There are two kinds. A base model only continues text. Ask it a question and it may write three more. A tuned model answers, and then it stops. {{template}} Underneath every chat is one long string, with the roles written in as special tokens. You will build that string by hand. {{card}} Then the model card: what the makers measured, and the date its knowledge stops. And what it never knew at all, which for a shop is almost everything that matters. {{ladder}} Last, the four ways to close the gap between a general model and your task, cheapest first.
